title: Normalization bridge from the finite-stage representative to ComparisonCompatible
statement: Fix the rational and common operation data of a finite-field compactified square and assume the canonical common pullback/tensor comparison has the finite-stage representative formula for every pair of rational inputs and every common coefficient stage above their tensor stage. Then the supplied pullback/tensor comparisons and the curried canonical tensorators are ComparisonCompatible with the inverse coefficient adjunction comparison.

source.place: Compatibility: normalize operation functors and cancel the finite-stage transition and scalar-unit maps

proof.text: Rewrite the rational and common tensor and pullback functors by their normalization equalities, and rewrite the supplied tensor/pullback components by their canonical normalization fields.

Evaluate the representative hypothesis at the chosen finite stage for the two rational inputs. Expand the two inclusion tensorators through commonInclusionTensorModel and cancel the scalar unit and transition isomorphisms by naturality. The resulting equality is exactly the pointwise ComparisonCompatible equation.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility: normalize and cancel the finite-stage representative formula

theorem projectionTensorComparisonCompatible_of_representative_formula
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    (H : SixFunctorCommonStages D C) (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar)
    (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D)
    [hZ : ∀ x : Q.Z.obj.left, Invertible (C.l : Q.Z.obj.left.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ x : Q.Y.obj.left, Invertible (C.l : Q.Y.obj.left.residueField x)]
    (hrep : ∀
      (M N : sfRationalConstructibleCategory C.l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient C.l C.Qbar E) Q.Y.obj.left)
      (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index C.l C.Qbar)
      (h : (commonStageTensorObject C.l C.Qbar Q.Y.obj.left
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M)
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N)).stage ≤ L),
      HEq (canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor C.l C.Qbar
        Q.p.hom.left
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M)
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N)).hom
        (ofHom (commonStagePullbackObject C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
          (commonStageTensorObject C.l C.Qbar Q.Y.obj.left
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M)
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N)))
          (commonStageTensorObject C.l C.Qbar Q.Z.obj.left
            (commonStagePullbackObject C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
              ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M))
            (commonStagePullbackObject C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
              ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N)))
          L h h (pullbackTensorAtCommonStage C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M)
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
              (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N) L h).hom)) :
    projectionTensorComparisonCompatible
      (S := (H.coefficientStages E).rational) (S' := H.commonStage)
      (T := (H.coefficientStages E).rationalTensor) (T' := H.commonStageTensor)
      (H.commonStageComparison E) (commonProjectionTensorComparison H E)
      ((H.coefficientStages E).rationalExchange Q) (H.commonStageExchange Q)
